reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate poschodoch.sk
reauth_confirm.description: Your poschodoch.sk session has expired or was revoked.

manual.title: Paste tokens manually
manual.description: Open https://www.poschodoch.sk, sign in, then in DevTools go to Application → Local Storage → www.poschodoch.sk and copy the values of both the `id_token` and `id_refresh_token` keys, pasted below. Both are needed together — the refresh call requires the current access token paired with its refresh token.

password.title: Sign in with email and password
password.description: Uses the same login as the poschodoch.sk website. An unrecognized device may be asked for a one-time code emailed to you — recognized devices can skip that step on future logins, including automatic re-authentication if your session ever expires.

two_factor.title: Enter the code from your email
two_factor.description: poschodoch.sk emailed a one-time code to verify this device.

error.invalid_auth: That was rejected. Make sure you entered the correct, current values and that you're still signed in on poschodoch.sk.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach poschodoch.sk. Check your connection and try again.
